newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr sharply down on U.S. dlr strength.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr sharply down on U.S. dlr strength.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar remained sharply lower against its U.S. counterpart at mid-session as the local currency, its key defence lifted by the central bank, succumbed to the greenback's strength overseas, dealers said.
At 0400 GMT, the local unit was at T$28.599 against Wednesday's T$28.480 finish.
Turnover through dealers was active at US$270.5 million.

The Taiwan on Tuesday allowed the Taiwan dollar to fall below T$28 for the first time since 1989, opening a floodgate for local dollar selling amid the greenback's strength against the yen and other major currencies.
But dealers said they expected the local unit to see a rebound later on Thursday.
"The feeling is that the U.S. dollar has hit a short-term peak, and profit-taking should begin," said one dealer.
